page.overview:
Who is Charonosaurus?

(meaning Charon's lizard) is an extinct genus of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/hadrosaurid hadrosaur] dinosaur whose fossils were discovered by Godefroit, Zan & Jin in 2000 on the south bank of the Amur River, dividing China from Russia. It had lived during the Late Cretaceous period.

Charonosaurus was a dinosaur that was originally gonna be added to Jurassic World Evolution, but was ultimately cut from the game.

Charonosaurus appears in the Dinosaur Field Guide as well as the Jurassic World Dinosaur Field Guide.
